description: Look up a state or empire by name or any of its Wikidata labels and aliases (substring, case-insensitive), or by Wikidata QID. Returns its lifespan, every border snapshot with its bounding box, and links.

lang.description: Site language for returned page and map links. Use the language the user is writing in.

query.description: Name, e.g. "Ottoman", or a QID, e.g. "Q12560".

name: find_polity
